arxiv-2102-05781.title: Complex BPS Skyrmions with real energy Conference: Complex BPS Skyrmions with real energy
arxiv-2102-05781.creator: Francisco Correa, Andreas Fring, Takanobu Taira ∙ \bullet Department of Mathematics, City, University of London, Northampton Square, London EC1V 0HB, UK ∘ \circ Instituto de Ciencias Físicas y Matemáticas, Universidad Austral de Chile, Casilla 567, Valdivia, ChileE-mail: francisco.correa@uach.cl, a.
arxiv-2102-05781.description: Abstract We propose and investigate several complex versions of extensions and restrictions of the Skyrme model with a well-defined Bogomolny-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) limit. The models studied possess complex kink, anti-kink, semi-kink, massless and purely imaginary compacton BPS solutions that all have real energies.

arxiv-2205-12389.title: non-degenerate minimal submanifolds as energy concentration sets: a variational approach
arxiv-2205-12389.creator: Guido De Philippis, Alessandro Pigati
arxiv-2205-12389.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guido De Philippis, Alessandro Pigati. We prove that every non-degenerate minimal submanifold of codimension two can be obtained as the energy concentration set of a family of critical maps for the (rescaled) Ginzburg–Landau functional. The proof is purely variational, and follows the strategy laid out by Jerrard and Sternberg in [ 20 ] , extending a recent result for geodesics by Colinet–Jerrard–Sternberg [ 10 ] .

arxiv-2207-06319.title: Stable Centres of Iwahori-Hecke Algebras of type A
arxiv-2207-06319.creator: Christopher Ryba
arxiv-2207-06319.description: Abstract . A celebrated result of Farahat and Higman constructs an algebra FH \mathrm{FH} which “interpolates” the centres Z ⁡ ( ℤ ​ S n ) Z(\mathbb{Z}S_{n}) of group algebras of the symmetric groups S n S_{n} . We extend these results from symmetric group algebras to type A A Iwahori-Hecke algebras, H n ​ ( q ) H_{n}(q) .

arxiv-2208-07218.title: SKYSURF-3: Testing Crowded Object Catalogs in the Hubble eXtreme Deep Field Mosaics to Study Sample Incompleteness from an Extragalactic Background Light Perspective SourceExtractor ( Bertin & Arnouts 1996 )
arxiv-2208-07218.creator: Darby M. Kramer, Timothy Carleton, Seth. H. Cohen, Rolf A. Jansen, Rogier A. Windhorst, Norman A. Grogin, Anton M. Koekemoer, John W. Mackenty, Norbert Pirzkal
arxiv-2208-07218.description: Abstract Extragalactic Background Light (EBL) studies have revealed a significant discrepancy between direct measurements — via instruments measuring “bare” sky from which Zodiacal and Galactic light models are subtracted — and measurements of the Integrated Galaxy Light (IGL). This discrepancy could lie in either method, whether it be an incomplete Zodiacal model or missed faint galaxies in the IGL calculations.

arxiv-2210-07547.title: Kernel-Whitening: Overcome Dataset Bias with Isotropic Sentence Embedding
arxiv-2210-07547.creator: Songyang Gao, Shihan Dou, Qi Zhang , Xuanjing Huang
arxiv-2210-07547.description: Abstract Dataset bias has attracted increasing attention recently for its detrimental effect on the generalization ability of fine-tuned models. The current mainstream solution is designing an additional shallow model to pre-identify biased instances. However, such two-stage methods scale up the computational complexity of training process and obstruct valid feature information while mitigating bias.

arxiv-2501-14418.title: Thunderdome : Timelock-Free Rationally-Secure Virtual Channels
arxiv-2501-14418.creator: Zeta Avarikioti, Yuheng Wang, Yuyi Wang
arxiv-2501-14418.description: Abstract Payment channel networks (PCNs) offer a promising solution to address the limited transaction throughput of deployed blockchains. However, several attacks have recently been proposed that stress the vulnerability of PCNs to timelock and censoring attacks. To address such attacks, we introduce Thunderdome , the first timelock-free PCN.

arxiv-2502-03149.title: Secure Resource Management in Cloud Computing: Challenges, Strategies and Meta-Analysis
arxiv-2502-03149.creator: Deepika Saxena, Smruti Rekha Swain, Jatinder Kumar, Sakshi Patni, Kishu Gupta, Ashutosh Kumar Singh, Volker Lindenstruth
arxiv-2502-03149.description: Abstract Secure resource management (SRM) within a cloud computing environment is a critical yet infrequently studied research topic. This paper provides a comprehensive survey and comparative performance evaluation of potential cyber threat countermeasure strategies that address security challenges during cloud workload execution and resource management.

arxiv-2509-16881.title: Survey on bounding Selmer groups for Rankin–Selberg motives
arxiv-2509-16881.creator: Yifeng Liu, Yichao Tian, Liang Xiao, Wei Zhang, Xinwen Zhu
arxiv-2509-16881.description: Abstract 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11G05, 11G18, 11G40, 11R34 1. Introduction Solving Diophantine equations has always been a central theme in the study of mathematics, since the ancient Greeks. In the context of modern algebraic geometry, the problem is integrated into the study of Chow groups of varieties defined over number fields.

arxiv-2510-05032.title: One rig to control them all
arxiv-2510-05032.creator: Chris Heunen, Robin Kaarsgaard, Louis Lemonnier
arxiv-2510-05032.description: Abstract We introduce a theory for computational control, consisting of eight naturally interpretable equations. Adding these to a prop of base circuits constructs controlled circuits, borne out in examples of reversible Boolean circuits and quantum circuits. We prove that this syntactic construction semantically corresponds to taking the free rig category on the base prop.

pmc-10550798.title: Archival skin biopsy specimens as a tool for miRNA-based diagnosis: Technical and post-analytical considerations
pmc-10550798.creator: Mirna Andelic, Margherita Marchi, Stefania Marcuzzo, Raffaella Lombardi, Catharina G. Faber, Giuseppe Lauria, Erika Salvi
pmc-10550798.description: Archived specimens, taken by standardized procedures in clinical practice, represent a valuable resource in translational medicine. Their use in retrospective molecular-based studies could provide disease and therapy predictors. Microfluidic array is a user-friendly and cost-effective method allowing profiling of hundreds of microRNAs (miRNAs) from a low amount of RNA.

pmc-10559937.title: Single-cell data analysis of malignant epithelial cell heterogeneity in lung adenocarcinoma for patient classification and prognosis prediction
pmc-10559937.creator: Xu Ran, Lu Tong, Wang Chenghao, Li Qi, Peng Bo, Zhao Jiaying, Wang Jun, Zhang Linyou
pmc-10559937.description: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related death. Most advanced lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) patients have poor survival because of drug resistance and relapse. Neglecting intratumoral heterogeneity might be one of the reasons for treatment insensitivity, while single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) technologies can provide transcriptome information at the single-cell level.

pmc-11357200.title: Deciphering Bacterial Chemorepulsion: The Complex Response of Microbes to Environmental Stimuli
pmc-11357200.creator: Ruixin Fu, Haichao Feng, Michael F Hynes
pmc-11357200.description: Bacterial motility relying on flagella is characterized by several modes, including swimming, swarming, twitching, and gliding. This motility allows bacteria to adapt remarkably well to hostile environments. More than 50% of bacteria naturally contain flagella, which are crucial for bacterial chemotaxis motility.

pmc-11457780.title: Nutritional Status and Inflammation as Mediators of Physical Performance and Delirium in Elderly Community-Acquired Pneumonia Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11457780.creator: Jingxian Liao, Xiaozhu Shen, Zhiqiang Du, Xiaojuan Wang, Lei Miao
pmc-11457780.description: PurposeThis study proposes a multiple mediation model to evaluate the association among diminished physical performance, malnutrition, inflammation, and delirium in seniors with community-acquired pneumonia.Patients and MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included elderly patients hospitalized for community-acquired pneumonia at the Geriatrics Department of the Second People’s Hospital of Lianyungang from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2024.

pmc-12643762.title: Extraction of gall bladder via umbilical port versus subxiphoid port for laparoscopic cholecystectomy in Pakistan: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12643762.creator: Syeda Zuha Sami, Sania Nisar, Alisha Ahmed, Inibehe Ime Okon
pmc-12643762.description: Background:Gallbladder retrieval site in laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) may influence postoperative outcomes, yet there is limited consensus on the optimal port for extraction. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to compare the umbilical port (UP) versus epigastric/subxiphoid port (EP/SP) in terms of clinical efficacy and safety.Methods:This review was conducted according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines.

pmc-12644330.title: PDK4 as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer: implications for metabolic regulation, immune modulation, and prognostic potential
pmc-12644330.creator: Jin Xu, Jie Sun, Nannan Zhang, Nan Sang, Buwei Teng, Wei He
pmc-12644330.description: ObjectiveGastric cancer (GC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with growing evidence implicating metabolic regulators in its progression. This study investigates the expression pattern, prognostic significance, molecular interactions, and immunomodulatory role of pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 4 (PDK4) in GC.MethodsIntegrated bioinformatics analyses were conducted using RNA sequencing and clinical data from the TCGA-STAD and GSE54129 datasets.

pmc-12653521.title: The lncRNA41584-miR3047-z-BmCDK20 ceRNA Regulatory Network Influences Reproductive Development in Male Silkworms (Bombyx mori)
pmc-12653521.creator: Tianchen Huang, Juan Sun, Shanshan Zhong, Dongxu Shen, Heying Qian, Qiaoling Zhao
pmc-12653521.description: Simple SummaryTissue-specific long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are emerging as important biomarkers for biological traits. This study investigated a testis-specific lncRNA, lncRNA41584, which was previously found to be under-expressed in male-sterile silkworm mutants. While its association with sterility was clear, the underlying mechanism remained unknown.

pmc-12748838.title: Microvascular skeletal muscle oxygenation and exercise capacity in childhood cancer survivors compared to healthy controls: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12748838.creator: Nel Van Ermengem, Deveny Vanrusselt, Anne Uyttebroeck, Véronique Cornelissen, Sabine Verschueren
pmc-12748838.description: The aim of the study was to evaluate skeletal muscle oxygenation and exercise capacity in childhood cancer survivors (CCS), and assess their association, in comparison with healthy controls. Twenty-six CCS (12 male, 6 months-10 yrs after treatment, mean age 17.59 (IQR:5.21 yrs) and 26 matched control subjects were recruited.

pmc-13191255.title: Design of a modular solver - Excel spreadsheet decision-support tool for calibrated nonlinear farm optimization in small holder farm systems
pmc-13191255.creator: Welcome Zimuto, Samuel Ahado, Tomas Ratinger, Jindrich Spicka
pmc-13191255.description: This study presents the design of a modular General Algebraic Modelling System (GAMS) solver integrated with an Excel spreadsheet as part of a decision-support system for implementing calibrated nonlinear farm optimization models under data-limited smallholder farm conditions. The study does not claim methodological innovation in nonlinear Positive Mathematical Programming or causal inference regarding farmer behavior.

pmc-13670804.title: Family functioning, attachment security, and psychological stress among university students attending a psychological counselling service: an exploratory cluster analysis
pmc-13670804.creator: Marco Cacioppo, Andrea Fontana, Eleonora Topino, Simona De Stasio, Giuseppe Mannino, Maria Concetta Pellicciari, Lucia Sideli
pmc-13670804.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPsychological stress is highly prevalent during higher education studies but mental health trajectories are shaped by risk and protective factors. Attachment security and balanced family functioning might reduce students’ psychological stress but literature is still limited.
